usedFor: Google Business Profile holds your reviews, and Cakemail gets a new contact from “New Review Posted” through “Add a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review Posted” in Google Business Profile, then “Add a Contact” in Cakemail
bestTemplate.why: The action adds a Cakemail contact each time a review lands, so reviewers join your list.

watchOut: “New Review Posted” in Google Business Profile is polling, so contacts reach Cakemail after a scheduled check.
